{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://json.schemastore.org/github-workflow.json

name: publish
on:
  workflow_dispatch: # Allow running the workflow manually from the GitHub UI
  push:
    branches:
      - 'master'     # Run the workflow when pushing to the default branch
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - '*'          # Run the workflow for all pull requests
  release:
    types:
      - published    # Run the workflow when a new GitHub release is published

# Least privilege by default; jobs opt in to anything more
permissions:
  contents: read

# Cancel superseded runs for the same branch/PR, but never cancel a release publish
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name != 'release' }}

env:
  DOTNET_SKIP_FIRST_TIME_EXPERIENCE: 1
  DOTNET_NOLOGO: true
  DOTNET_CLI_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT: true
  NuGetDirectory: ${{ github.workspace }}/nuget

defaults:
  run:
    shell: pwsh

jobs:
  create_nuget:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      with:
        fetch-depth: 0 # Get all history to allow automatic versioning using MinVer
        persist-credentials: false

    - name: Setup .NET
      uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v6  # SDK version from global.json

    - name: Cache NuGet packages
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: ~/.nuget/packages
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-nuget-${{ hashFiles('**/*.csproj', '**/packages.lock.json') }}
        restore-keys: |
          ${{ runner.os }}-nuget-

    # Create the NuGet package in the folder from the environment variable NuGetDirectory
    - run: dotnet pack --configuration Release --output ${{ env.NuGetDirectory }}

    # Publish the NuGet package as an artifact, so they can be used in the following jobs
    - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
      with:
        name: nuget
        if-no-files-found: error
        retention-days: 7
        path: ${{ env.NuGetDirectory }}/*.nupkg

  validate_nuget:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    needs: [ create_nuget ]
    steps:
      - name: Setup .NET
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v6  # SDK version from global.json

      # Download the NuGet package created in the previous job
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v8
        with:
          name: nuget
          path: ${{ env.NuGetDirectory }}

      - name: Install nuget validator
        run: dotnet tool update Meziantou.Framework.NuGetPackageValidation.Tool --global

      # Validate metadata and content of the NuGet package
      # https://www.nuget.org/packages/Meziantou.Framework.NuGetPackageValidation.Tool#readme-body-tab
      # If some rules are not applicable, you can disable them
      # using the --excluded-rules or --excluded-rule-ids option
      - name: Validate package
        run: meziantou.validate-nuget-package (Get-ChildItem "${{ env.NuGetDirectory }}/*.nupkg")

  run_test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      with:
        persist-credentials: false
    - name: Setup .NET
      uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v6  # SDK version from global.json
    - name: Cache NuGet packages
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: ~/.nuget/packages
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-nuget-${{ hashFiles('**/*.csproj', '**/packages.lock.json') }}
        restore-keys: |
          ${{ runner.os }}-nuget-
    - name: Run tests
      run: dotnet test --configuration Release

  deploy:
    # Publish only when creating a GitHub Release
    # https://docs.github.com/en/repositories/releasing-projects-on-github/managing-releases-in-a-repository
    if: github.event_name == 'release'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    needs: [ validate_nuget, run_test ]
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write   # Required for NuGet trusted publishing (OIDC)
    steps:
      # Download the NuGet package created in the previous job
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v8
        with:
          name: nuget
          path: ${{ env.NuGetDirectory }}

      - name: Setup .NET
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v6  # SDK version from global.json

      # Trusted publishing: exchanges the GitHub OIDC token for a short-lived NuGet API key.
      # Requires a Trusted Publishing policy on nuget.org for this repo and publish.yml.
      - name: NuGet login (OIDC)
        id: login
        uses: NuGet/login@v1
        with:
          user: ${{ vars.NUGET_USER }}

      # Publish all NuGet packages to NuGet.org
      # Use --skip-duplicate to prevent errors if a package with the same version already exists.
      # If you retry a failed workflow, already published packages will be skipped without error.
      - name: Publish NuGet package
        env:
          NUGET_API_KEY: ${{ steps.login.outputs.NUGET_API_KEY }}
        run: |
          foreach($file in (Get-ChildItem "${{ env.NuGetDirectory }}" -Recurse -Include *.nupkg)) {
              dotnet nuget push $file --api-key "$env:NUGET_API_KEY" --source https://api.nuget.org/v3/index.json --skip-duplicate
          }
",
  "rationale": "The workflow is a .NET NuGet publish/test workflow with repeated CI runs (three successful runs in history) and no dependency cache. `dotnet pack` (create_nuget) and `dotnet test` (run_test) restore NuGet packages on every run. The P-LIT-GHA-CACHE pattern (reported benefit: about 6% free / 3.4% paid VM-time reduction) supports caching dependency downloads when repeated fetching is measurable and cache inputs include lockfile/environment. Both preconditions are met: repeated runs exist, and the cache key is keyed off `**/*.csproj` and `**/packages.lock.json` so dependency changes invalidate it. No contraindication applies: there is no existing equivalent cache, and the cached NuGet packages are pinned dependency downloads, not mutable build outputs. Adding `actions/cache` for `~/.nuget/packages` in create_nuget and run_test preserves every build/test/validate/deploy step and required check, adds no privileges, secrets, publishing changes, or new external network access, and does not weaken permissions.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}
